## 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

## ❓ Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe (e.g., *I'm frustrated when...*).

## 🚀 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution or user experience you would like to see implemented.

## 🎨 Alternatives Considered
A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📐 Impacted Packages
- [ ] `apps/web` (Next.js Application)

- [ ] `packages/ui` (shadcn/ui Design System)
- [ ] Workspace Tooling / Configs

## ➕ Additional Context
Add any mockups, wireframes, or reference URLs.
